Selke 50 Lady Byng 45 Name: count, dtype: int64 ``` ::: ::: Add first names to some entries that only had last names ::: {#273cd516 .cell execution_count=12} ``` {.python .cell-code} combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Ekholm", value = "Mattias Ekholm", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Slavis", value = "Jaccob Slavin", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Toews", value = "Devon Toews", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Gotisbere", value = "Shayne Gostisbehere", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Orlov", value = "Dmitry Orlov", inplace = True) ``` ::: Add point system for the ranks. A player gets 10 points for a 1st place showing on the ballot, 7 points for a 2nd, 5 for a third, 3 for a fourth, and one point for a 5th. ::: {#55da1bbd .cell execution_count=13} ``` {.python .cell-code} conditions = [ combinedDF["Rank"] == 1, combinedDF["Rank"] == 2, combinedDF["Rank"] == 3, combinedDF["Rank"] == 4, combinedDF["Rank"] == 5 ] values = [10, 7, 5, 3, 1] combinedDF["AwardPoints"] = np.select(conditions, values, default = 0) combinedDF["AwardPoints"] = combinedDF["AwardPoints"].astype(int) ``` ::: Fix typos in player names ::: {#045bd17f .cell execution_count=14} ``` {.python .cell-code} combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Shayne Gostisbere", value = "Shayne Gostisbehere", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Shayne Godtisbehertr", value = "Shayne Gostisbehere", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Shayne Gostisbeher", value = "Shayne Gostisbehere", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Leon Draisaitl ", value = "Leon Draisaitl", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Conner Hellebuyck", value = "Connor Hellebuyck", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Cale Maker", value = "Cale Makar", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Shayne Gotisbehere", value = "Shayne Gostisbehere", inplace = True) combinedDF.replace(to_replace = "Kirill Machenko", value = "Kirill Marchenko", inplace = True) ``` ::: Split dataframe into 6 different dataframes, one for each award. ::: {#13d1523d .cell execution_count=15} ``` {.python .cell-code} Hart = combinedDF[combinedDF["Award"] == "Hart"] Vezina = combinedDF[combinedDF["Award"] == "Vezina"] Norris = combinedDF[combinedDF["Award"] == "James Norris"] Calder = combinedDF[combinedDF["Award"] == "Calder"] Selke = combinedDF[combinedDF["Award"] == "Frank J. Selke"] Byng = combinedDF[combinedDF["Award"] == "Lady Byng"] ``` ::: ## Visualizing the Ballot Now we create bar charts that visualize how each skater performed. ### Hart ::: {#11ac2186 .cell execution_count=16} ``` {.python .cell-code} HartBar = go.Figure() HartBar.add_trace(go.Bar( x = Hart["AwardPoints"], y = Hart["Player"], orientation = 'h' )) HartBar.update_layout( height = 1000, yaxis = {'categoryorder' : 'total ascending'}, title_text = 'Hart Memorial Trophy Voting Results' ) HartBar.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: Unfortunately, despite all efforts to clean the data, some duplicate names remain. Notably, each of the duplicates that occurred come from the 'Barrie' portion of the dataframe, so we can manually add the results of his ballot to the others to get the final result. In this case of the Hart Trophy, it does matter, since two 7 point ballots were not properly combined for Zach Werenski. The final score of 14 would be enough to take 5th place in this ballot over David Pastrnak. In addition, this provided an extra point for Nikita Kucherov, which places him in a tie for 3rd place with Shayne Gostisbehere. Nikita has one 1st and two 2nds among the voters, while Shayne has one 1st and only one 2nd, so Nikita will take third on a tiebreak. ::: {#53b60d5b .cell execution_count=17} ``` {.python .cell-code} HartBallot = pd.DataFrame({"Hart": ["Leon Draisaitl", "Nathan MacKinnon", "Nikita Kucherov", "Shayne Gostisbehere", "Zach Werenski"]}) ``` ::: ### Vezina ::: {#4242857b .cell execution_count=18} ``` {.python .cell-code} VezinaBar = go.Figure() VezinaBar.add_trace(go.Bar( x = Vezina["AwardPoints"], y = Vezina["Player"], orientation = 'h' )) VezinaBar.update_layout( height = 1000, yaxis = {'categoryorder' : 'total ascending'}, title_text = 'Vezina Trophy Voting Results' ) VezinaBar.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: Like before, we need to manually add Barrie's results to the rest of the combined group. His Vezina ballot matches the overall results pretty well, so the order in this graph matches the overall ballot. ::: {#820ed8dd .cell execution_count=19} ``` {.python .cell-code} VezinaBallot = pd.DataFrame({"Vezina": ["Connor Hellebuyck", "Andrei Vasilevskiy", "Logan Thompson", "Mackenzie Blackwood", "Dustin Wolf"]}) ``` ::: ### Norris ::: {#dc9f5d13 .cell execution_count=20} ``` {.python .cell-code} NorrisBar = go.Figure() NorrisBar.add_trace(go.Bar( x = Norris["AwardPoints"], y = Norris["Player"], orientation = 'h', )) NorrisBar.update_layout( height = 1000, yaxis = {'categoryorder' : 'total ascending'}, title_text = 'Norris Memorial Trophy Voting Results' ) NorrisBar.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: Here, Barrie's ballot does significantly influence the results, boosting Quinn Hughes (now with 20 points) above Ian Cole (18) and Zach Werenski (15) & Evan Bouchard (13) onto the ballot entirely. ::: {#b28b932d .cell execution_count=21} ``` {.python .cell-code} NorrisBallot = pd.DataFrame({"Norris": ["Cale Makar", "Quinn Hughes", "Ian Cole", "Zach Werenski", "Evan Bouchard"]}) ``` ::: ### Calder ::: {#b0d19111 .cell execution_count=22} ``` {.python .cell-code} CalderBar = go.Figure() CalderBar.add_trace(go.Bar( x = Calder["AwardPoints"], y = Calder["Player"], orientation = 'h' )) CalderBar.update_layout( height = 1000, yaxis = {'categoryorder' : 'total ascending'}, title_text = 'Calder Memorial Trophy Voting Results' ) CalderBar.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: Barrie's results did not affect this award. However, there is a 3-way tie for 5th place, and each recipient has only a single first-place vote. So all three are just placed on here as a tie. ::: {#4d1de818 .cell execution_count=23} ``` {.python .cell-code} CalderBallot = pd.DataFrame({"Calder": ["Kirill Marchenko", "Wyatt Johnston", "Marco Rossi", "Dylan Holloway", "Nathan Cluman, Jake Sanders, Bobby Brink"]}) ``` ::: ### Selke ::: {#9eec962a .cell execution_count=24} ``` {.python .cell-code} SelkeBar = go.Figure() SelkeBar.add_trace(go.Bar( x = Selke["AwardPoints"], y = Selke["Player"], orientation = 'h' )) SelkeBar.update_layout( height = 1000, yaxis = {'categoryorder' : 'total ascending'}, title_text = 'Frank J. selke Trophy Voting Results' ) SelkeBar.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: Barrie's ballot has no impact here. Notably, Alex Tuch and Fabian Zetterlund tie for 4th place with 2 second-place ballots apiece, so no seperating these two. ::: {#44d47829 .cell execution_count=25} ``` {.python .cell-code} SelkeBallot = pd.DataFrame({"Selke": ["Brandon Tanev", "Jackson Blake", "Nathan MacKinnon", "Alex Tuch", "Fabian Zetterlund"]}) ``` ::: ### Byng ::: {#2a9d79c4 .cell execution_count=26} ``` {.python .cell-code} Byng.replace(to_replace = "Brayed Point", value = "Brayden Point", inplace = True) ``` ::: ::: {#d8c8ef44 .cell execution_count=27} ``` {.python .cell-code} ByngBar = go.Figure() ByngBar.add_trace(go.Bar( x = Byng["AwardPoints"], y = Byng["Player"], orientation = 'h' )) ByngBar.update_layout( height = 1000, yaxis = {'categoryorder' : 'total ascending'}, title_text = 'Lady Byng Trophy Voting Results' ) ByngBar.show() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: Barrie's ballot does affect this overall ballot, as Cale Makar (now with 23 points) takes second place, just behind Brayden Point (now with 25 points). However, theres now a massive logjam at 10 points, with numerous people with 1 first place vote, and three with two 2nd place votes. After some deliberation, the 2 second place votes get the tiebreaker here. One of them takes "6th place". ::: {#db62439c .cell execution_count=28} ``` {.python .cell-code} ByngBallot = pd.DataFrame({'Byng': ["Brayden Point", "Cale Makar", "Jack Eichel", "Alex Vlasic", "Cole Schwindt, Martin Necas"]}) ``` ::: ### Final Ballot Now we combine the ballots together into one final overall ballot. ::: {#31b0fcf7 .cell execution_count=29} ``` {.python .cell-code} finalBallot = pd.concat([HartBallot, VezinaBallot, NorrisBallot, CalderBallot, SelkeBallot, ByngBallot], axis = 1) print(finalBallot) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Hart Vezina Norris \ 0 Leon Draisaitl Connor Hellebuyck Cale Makar 1 Nathan MacKinnon Andrei Vasilevskiy Quinn Hughes 2 Nikita Kucherov Logan Thompson Ian Cole 3 Shayne Gostisbehere Mackenzie Blackwood Zach Werenski 4 Zach Werenski Dustin Wolf Evan Bouchard Calder Selke \ 0 Kirill Marchenko Brandon Tanev 1 Wyatt Johnston Jackson Blake 2 Marco Rossi Nathan MacKinnon 3 Dylan Holloway Alex Tuch 4 Nathan Cluman, Jake Sanders, Bobby Brink Fabian Zetterlund Byng 0 Brayden Point 1 Cale Makar 2 Jack Eichel 3 Alex Vlasic 4 Cole Schwindt, Martin Necas ``` ::: :::
